Equivariant Alexander duality contributes the ambient sign and the dimension shift. The Hom–Ext connecting map is reduction modulo m, while an explicit m-fold lift and restriction to one edge prove exact extension order m. The verifier passed 192 signed Lefschetz comparisons and small exact mod-two boundary-rank checks; these do not replace the infinite integral proof.

value.rationale: Extends an established path-factor counting result to arbitrary branching trees and determines the actual integer lattice under a natural symmetry group, not just its Betti number. The canonical equivariant extension has exact order \(m\), unbounded with clique size, and vanishes rationally, revealing meaningful arithmetic information which ordinary ranks and rational characters miss. Every parameter \(m\ge2\) and finite tree \(T\) of order at least two is geometrically motivated, not an arbitrary finite slice.
